annotations.title: Find the trade size with the best odds

description: Runs the same trades (or headline numbers) at eight trade sizes, from a quarter to three times, against up to three accounts, and shows the pass and first-payout chance at each with the best size marked. Answers "should I risk less or more per trade on this challenge?". Give trades with starting_balance, or the four headline numbers.

reward_to_risk.description: Average win divided by average loss, for example 2 for a 1:2 strategy.

risk_per_trade.description: Percentage of the account lost on a losing trade, for example 1.

trades.description: Closed trades in the order they closed.

date.description: Close date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give it for every trade or for none.

profit.description: Profit (positive) or loss (negative) in account currency, after costs.

trades_per_day.description: Average trades per trading day, for example 1.5.

win_rate.description: Percentage of trades that win, for example 45.

name: find_best_size
title: Find the trade size with the best odds
